title: GitHub - ansnadeem/mlxsh: A lightweight mlx server cli that allows running multiple models at once
excerpt: A lightweight mlx server cli that allows running multiple models at once - ansnadeem/mlxsh
content_html:
Run local MLX models on Apple silicon. mlxsh serves a model at an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, keeps several loaded at once, switches a model between text-only and multimodal, and browses and downloads from the Hugging Face Hub. One file, standard library only; it drives mlx-lm and mlx-vlm.

mlxsh> lm gemma-4-26B             serve it at http://127.0.0.1:41277/v1
mlxsh> lm qwen3.6                 a second model, the first keeps running
mlxsh> ask --on qwen "hello"      no extra copy is loaded
mlxsh> stop all

macOS on Apple silicon, Python 3.10 or newer. Driving mlxsh from a script or a coding agent: AGENTS.md.

Install

curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ansnadeem/mlxsh/main/install.sh | sh
mlxsh setup

The first line installs uv if it is missing, then mlxsh with both engines. The second is only needed if something is missing: it installs mlx-lm, mlx-vlm and huggingface_hub into whichever environment mlxsh runs from, about 300 MB. mlxsh doctor shows what it found.

State lives in ~/.mlxsh/: the registry, one file per running server, logs and history. Override with MLXSH_HOME.

The two modes

mode engine what loads
lm mlx_lm text weights only, no vision tower
vision mlx_vlm the full multimodal stack

Most MLX repos are vision-capable, so the mode picks the engine, not the model. Loading a model that is already running in the other mode swaps the engine on the same port.

Several models at once

One model per port. When the configured port is busy the next model takes the next free port, so nothing running is stopped by accident.

mlxsh> status
  lm      gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-4bit    15.0 GB   up 01:15   http://127.0.0.1:41277/v1
  vision  gemma-4-31b-it-4bit            18.4 GB   up 00:59   http://127.0.0.1:41278/v1
  2 servers, 33.4 GB resident now, about 33.4 GB of weights, machine has 68.7 GB

stop, bench, ask, chat and log take a port, a model substring or a mode: stop 41278, bench gemma, ask --on vision "...", stop all. Leave the argument off in the shell and you get a picker. --new forces a new port, --replace reuses the configured one, and config when_busy sets the default.

Before adding a model mlxsh adds up the weights already loaded and asks if the new one will not fit. -y skips the question.

Using the endpoint

Any OpenAI client works. There is no API key.

curl -s http://127.0.0.1:41277/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"default_model","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'

default_model means whatever that port was started with, so a client pinned to a port needs no repo id. An exact repo id works too, and mlxsh status --json reports it.

GET /v1/models on a port lists that one model. mlx_lm builds that list by scanning the Hugging Face cache, so a server started against the real cache advertises every model on the machine and clients cannot tell which is loaded; mlxsh gives each server a cache view holding only its own model. That also stops a stray request from swapping the model out or downloading another one. config pin_model off restores mlx_lm's behaviour.

The servers have no authentication and bind to 127.0.0.1; config host 0.0.0.0 exposes them to your network.

Commands

mlxsh                    this list
mlxsh shell              the list, then the interactive shell
mlxsh <command> ...      run one command and exit

lm [model]               serve text only
vision [model]           serve multimodal
stop [port|model|all]    stop a server and free the memory
status [--json]          what is running
bench [port|model] [n]   measure tok/s, saved to the registry
log [port|model] [n]     tail one server's log

models                   pick a model, then pick an action
ls [--json]              the same list as plain text
use [model] [mode]       set the default for lm or vision
rm [model] [-y]          delete from disk

browse [filters]         live list from hugging face, space marks downloads
get [n|repo] [-y]        download from that list, or by repo id

ask <text>               single prompt, --image PATH sends a picture
chat                     a chat loop
--on <port|model>        which running model answers
--load                   load a private copy instead of using a server

config                   settings, and where each value comes from
doctor                   versions, paths, machine
setup                    install the MLX packages
edit                     open the registry in $EDITOR
help                     this list

--port N, --host ADDR    override the address for one run
--foreground             run a server attached to this terminal

model is a repo id, a number from ls, or a unique substring: lm 3, lm qwen3.6, vision gemma-4-31b. A command that prints error: exits non-zero.

mlxsh <command> -h explains one command with examples. Errors go to stderr and exit non-zero, so a command composes in a pipeline.

Every command works both one-shot and in the shell. The shell adds what only makes sense while you are sitting in it: a picker whenever you leave an argument off, a command list on an empty line, tab completion, history, a chat loop, and a line pinned to the top showing what is loaded (config status_bar off hides it). One-shot runs never open a picker, so scripts stay predictable.

In a picker: up/down or j/k move, type to filter, enter selects, space marks several, esc cancels.

browse estimates each repo's memory from its safetensors dtypes, so 4-bit packing is counted correctly, and hides what will not fit unless you ask for all. Filters: vision, text, trending, popular, new, all, any other word searches, and org/ scopes to an org.

Settings

config                   list settings and their source
config port 8080         change one
config reset port        back to the default

Flag beats environment beats registry beats default.

setting env default
host MLXSH_HOST 127.0.0.1
port MLXSH_PORT 41277
org MLXSH_ORG mlx-community
mem_comfy MLXSH_MEM_COMFY 0.7
mem_tight MLXSH_MEM_TIGHT 0.85
browse_limit MLXSH_BROWSE_LIMIT 25
start_timeout MLXSH_START_TIMEOUT 900
reply_timeout MLXSH_REPLY_TIMEOUT 600
when_busy MLXSH_WHEN_BUSY new
pin_model MLXSH_PIN_MODEL on
status_bar MLXSH_STATUS_BAR on
bar_interval MLXSH_BAR_INTERVAL 2.0

Also read: MLXSH_HOME, MLXSH_PYTHON, MLXSH_DEBUG, HF_TOKEN, NO_COLOR.

Troubleshooting

symptom what to do
port 41277 is held by pid N, not an mlx server config port <n>, or stop that process
a model exits during startup log shows the last lines: usually an unsupported architecture or memory
everything is slow with several models loaded they compete for bandwidth, stop one
a thinking model answers nothing it spent its budget reasoning, raise config ask_args
downloads are rate limited set HF_TOKEN

doctor is the first thing to include in a bug report. MLXSH_DEBUG=1 turns an unexpected error into a traceback.

Uninstall

uv tool uninstall mlxsh
rm -rf ~/.mlxsh

Models live in the Hugging Face cache, not in ~/.mlxsh.

Tests

python3 -m unittest discover -s tests

No network, no models, no MLX packages needed.

More

  • AGENTS.md for scripts and coding agents
  • CHANGELOG.md, CONTRIBUTING.md
  • MIT, see LICENSE

content_html_zh:
在 Apple 芯片上运行本地 MLX 模型。 mlxsh 在兼容 OpenAI 的端点上提供模型，同时加载多个模型，在纯文本和多模式之间切换模型，并从 Hugging Face Hub 浏览和下载。 一个文件，仅标准库；它驱动 mlx-lm 和 mlx-vlm。

mlxsh> lm gemma-4-26B             serve it at http://127.0.0.1:41277/v1
mlxsh> lm qwen3.6                 a second model, the first keeps running
mlxsh> ask --on qwen "hello"      no extra copy is loaded
mlxsh> stop all

Apple 芯片上的 macOS、Python 3.10 或更高版本。 从脚本或编码代理驱动 mlxsh：AGENTS.md。

安装

curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ansnadeem/mlxsh/main/install.sh | sh
mlxsh setup

第一行安装 uv（如果缺少），然后使用两个引擎安装 mlxsh。 仅当缺少某些内容时才需要第二个：它将 mlx-lm、mlx-vlm 和 Huggingface_hub 安装到 mlxsh 运行的任何环境中，大约 300 MB。 mlxsh doctor 展示了它的发现。

状态位于 ~/.mlxsh/ 中：注册表、每个正在运行的服务器一个文件、日志和历史记录。 使用 MLXSH_HOME 覆盖。

两种模式

mode 引擎 加载什么
lm mlx_lm 仅文本权重，无视觉塔
想象 MLX_VLM 完整的多式联运堆栈

大多数 MLX 存储库都具有视觉功能，因此该模式选择引擎，而不是模型。 加载已在其他模式下运行的模型会交换同一端口上的引擎。

同时使用多个模型

每个端口一个型号。 当配置的端口繁忙时，下一个模型将占用下一个空闲端口，因此任何运行都不会意外停止。

mlxsh> status
  lm      gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-4bit    15.0 GB   up 01:15   http://127.0.0.1:41277/v1
  vision  gemma-4-31b-it-4bit            18.4 GB   up 00:59   http://127.0.0.1:41278/v1
  2 servers, 33.4 GB resident now, about 33.4 GB of weights, machine has 68.7 GB

stop、bench、ask、chat 和 log 采用端口、模型子字符串或模式：stop 41278、bench gemma、ask --on Vision“...”、停止全部。 将参数保留在 shell 中，您将得到一个选择器。 --new 强制使用新端口，--replace 重用已配置的端口，configwhen_busy 设置默认端口。

在添加模型之前，mlxsh 会添加已加载的重量，并询问新的重量是否不适合。 -y 跳过该问题。

使用端点

任何 OpenAI 客户端都可以使用。 没有 API 密钥。

curl -s http://127.0.0.1:41277/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"default_model","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'

default_model 表示该端口启动的任何内容，因此固定到端口的客户端不需要 repo id。 确切的存储库 ID 也可以使用，mlxsh status --json 会报告它。

端口上的 GET /v1/models 会列出该模型。 mlx_lm 通过扫描 Hugging Face 缓存来构建该列表，因此针对真实缓存启动的服务器会通告计算机上的每个模型，而客户端无法判断加载了哪个模型； mlxsh 为每个服务器提供一个仅保存其自己模型的缓存视图。 这还可以阻止杂散请求更换模型或下载另一个模型。 config pin_model off 恢复 mlx_lm 的行为。

服务器没有身份验证并绑定到127.0.0.1； config host 0.0.0.0 将它们暴露给您的网络。

命令

mlxsh                    this list
mlxsh shell              the list, then the interactive shell
mlxsh <command> ...      run one command and exit

lm [model]               serve text only
vision [model]           serve multimodal
stop [port|model|all]    stop a server and free the memory
status [--json]          what is running
bench [port|model] [n]   measure tok/s, saved to the registry
log [port|model] [n]     tail one server's log

models                   pick a model, then pick an action
ls [--json]              the same list as plain text
use [model] [mode]       set the default for lm or vision
rm [model] [-y]          delete from disk

browse [filters]         live list from hugging face, space marks downloads
get [n|repo] [-y]        download from that list, or by repo id

ask <text>               single prompt, --image PATH sends a picture
chat                     a chat loop
--on <port|model>        which running model answers
--load                   load a private copy instead of using a server

config                   settings, and where each value comes from
doctor                   versions, paths, machine
setup                    install the MLX packages
edit                     open the registry in $EDITOR
help                     this list

--port N, --host ADDR    override the address for one run
--foreground             run a server attached to this terminal

model 是一个 repo id、来自 ls 的数字或唯一的子字符串：lm 3、lm qwen3.6、vision gemma-4-31b。 打印错误的命令：退出非零。

mlxsh <command> -h 通过示例解释一个命令。 错误会转到 stderr 并以非零值退出，因此命令会在管道中组成。

每个命令都可以一次性运行，也可以在 shell 中运行。 shell 添加了只有在您坐在其中时才有意义的内容：每当您关闭参数时的选择器、空行上的命令列表、制表符完成、历史记录、聊天循环以及固定在顶部的显示加载内容的行（config status_bar off 隐藏它）。 一次性运行永远不会打开选择器，因此脚本保持可预测性。

在选择器中：向上/向下或 j/k 移动、键入进行过滤、输入选择、空格标记多个、ESC 取消。

browser 根据其安全张量 dtypes 估计每个存储库的内存，因此 4 位打包会被正确计算，并隐藏不适合的内容，除非您要求全部。 过滤器：愿景、文本、趋势、流行、新、所有、任何其他单词搜索以及组织/组织范围。

设置

config                   list settings and their source
config port 8080         change one
config reset port        back to the default

标志击败环境击败注册表击败默认值。

环境 env 默认
host MLXSH_HOST 127.0.0.1
port MLXSH_PORT 41277
org MLXSH_ORG MLX 社区
记忆舒适 MLXSH_MEM_COMFY 0.7
内存紧 MLXSH_MEM_TIGHT 0.85
浏览限制 MLXSH_BROWSE_LIMIT 25
开始超时 MLXSH_START_TIMEOUT 900
回复超时 MLXSH_REPLY_TIMEOUT 600
当_忙时 MLXSH_WHEN_BUSY new
引脚型号 MLXSH_PIN_MODEL on
状态栏 MLXSH_STATUS_BAR on
条形间隔 MLXSH_BAR_INTERVAL 2.0

另请阅读：MLXSH_HOME、MLXSH_PYTHON、MLXSH_DEBUG、HF_TOKEN、NO_COLOR。

故障排除

症状 该怎么办
端口 41277 由 pid N 持有，而不是 mlx 服务器 配置端口 <n>，或停止该进程
模型在启动期间退出 日志显示最后几行：通常是不支持的架构或内存
加载多个模型时一切都很慢 他们争夺带宽，停止一个
思维模型无法回答任何问题 它花费了预算推理，提高配置ask_args
下载有速率限制 设置 HF_TOKEN

doctor 是错误报告中首先要包含的内容。 MLXSH_DEBUG=1 将意外错误转变为回溯。

卸载

uv tool uninstall mlxsh
rm -rf ~/.mlxsh

模型位于 Hugging Face 缓存中，而不是 ~/.mlxsh 中。

Tests

python3 -m unittest discover -s tests

无需网络、无需型号、无需 MLX 软件包。
